description: This is where it all began with a bike called the Freestyler. No other bike has the heritage and proven performance that comes from being a direct descendent of the first freestyle bike ever developed. From basic to flatland specific bikes, the quality and value of the Freestyle series demonstrates why Haro is still ‘first in freestyle’ after twenty five years in the sport.
